##### Project general facts

Jannat is the final residential phase within the Midtown master-planned community by Deyaar, offering a collection of signature residences designed around contemporary living standards. The project features studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments with open-plan layouts, private balconies or terraces, and carefully organized living spaces. The architectural and interior design approach emphasizes functionality, natural light, and modern aesthetics, creating residences that combine comfort with practical everyday living. The development is positioned as a premium residential offering within an established integrated community.

Residents have access to a wide range of lifestyle and recreational amenities designed to support wellness, leisure, and social interaction. The development incorporates landscaped green spaces, recreational areas, and modern community facilities that encourage an active and balanced lifestyle. A variety of indoor and outdoor amenities provide opportunities for relaxation, fitness, and family-oriented activities.

The residences feature modern finishes with built-in wardrobes, open-plan living and dining areas, private balconies or terraces, and well-designed bathroom layouts. Selected unit types include dedicated laundry rooms, maid’s rooms, walk-in closets, and en-suite bathrooms. Kitchens feature an open design and are equipped with a cooker top, oven, sink, hood, refrigerator, dishwasher (in one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments), and washing machine. Apartments are delivered without furniture.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Production City is a vibrant community designed to foster creativity and innovation, primarily catering to the media, production, and publishing industries. Strategically located near key highways, it offers excellent connectivity to Dubai’s major hubs, including the Dubai Marina and Al Maktoum International Airport. The area is characterized by its modern infrastructure, tailored to meet the needs of businesses, while also offering a dynamic environment for professionals and residents alike.

Beyond its business focus, Dubai Production City provides a balanced lifestyle with a range of amenities. Residential complexes within the district feature contemporary designs and cater to a diverse community. With parks, retail outlets, cafes, and fitness centers, the area promotes a lifestyle of convenience and leisure. Educational institutions and healthcare facilities within close reach further enhance its appeal as a well-rounded community.

Dubai Production City also emphasizes sustainability and green living, integrating eco-friendly practices into its design. Lush landscapes and open spaces are thoughtfully incorporated, providing a refreshing environment for residents and visitors. Whether you’re a business professional seeking a dynamic workspace or a family looking for a vibrant neighborhood, Dubai Production City offers a unique blend of innovation, comfort, and connectivity.
